facts.statement: SOE ran Presidents' Day weekend special offers and events across several games, including Free Realms, starting February 18.
facts.quote: encontraran ofertas especiales exclusivas para cada juego empezando el 18 de febrero

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a Spanish-language SOE site notice announcing a Presidents' Day weekend promotion across many SOE games, including Free Realms. It gives no Free Realms-specific details; it only says offers begin February 18 and may include bonus XP days, item discounts, or new items. The post date is not shown on the page (only a relative 'Posted 3 months, 2 weeks ago' stamp), so the year is uncertain.
